messages:
Incident-Bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: regional-health/eu-west-2 -> elevated 5xx + outbound latency causing partial failover. Condition: region_5xx_rate > 3% over 3m. PD: https://pd.example/INC90210. Alert details: https://alerts.redwood.company/90210
Priya: taking oncall. seeing sudden hop of 18% of traffic to sa-east-1 and increased tokenization errors from proxy stacks. opening timeline and starting mitigation.
Marcus: joining. I see most 5xxs are from the inference-proxy pool (upstream 502s) and there's a surge in client retries from mobile-sdk/5.1.2. lots of small rapid retries.
Elena: quick check on infra side: cloud-edge in eu-west-2 shows intermittent egress errors to partner embeddings service, provider reported a transient DNS flapping event at 2048572940. provider link: https://status.cloud/notice/2401
Oncall-Joe: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) apply client-side throttle for SDKs with aggressive retries, 2) temporarily reduce failover aggressiveness so we don't move too much traffic and create cross-region latency, 3) increase alert evaluation window to avoid paging on short flaps.
Failover-Bot: Failover executed: cross-region preference set to conservative at 2048573100; routed 70% stay-local, 30% balancing.
Observability-Bot: Synthetic checks failing: eu-west-2/smoke_tokenize 5/5 at 2048573050. Added ephemeral dashboard panel: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/regional/emergency-eu-west-2
Priya: applying SDK throttle rule: header_throttle: mobile-sdk/5.1.2 -> 30r/s per client at 2048573120. pushing change to prod.
Marcus: applying retry-policy tweak: set cross-region retry backoff base=2000ms, max_retries=2 for non-critical routes. Config applied at 2048573130.
SRE-Lead: flagging for follow-ups: current alert is percent-only and triggered by small-volume retry storms; we should change to: fire when (region_5xx_rate > 3% for 5m) AND (abs_5xx_count > 150 in 5m) OR (traffic_shift > 15% in 3m). Open INF-90211 to track alert-rule changes and dashboard additions.
Elena: added a temporary Prometheus query to incident dashboard to show regional traffic fraction and absolute errors: ```
# region error rate and absolute errors (5m)
sum(increase(http_server_errors_total{job=\"proxy\",region=~\"eu-.*\"}[5m])) by (region)
/ sum(increase(http_requests_total{job=\"proxy\",region=~\"eu-.*\"}[5m])) by (region)

sum(increase(http_server_errors_total{job=\"proxy\",region=~\"eu-.*\"}[5m])) by (region)
```
Panel: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/regional/ephemeral-90210
Oncall-Joe: added a quick runbook snippet here: ```
If eu-west-2 5xx >3% for 5m AND abs_errors >150:
1. Check provider status + DNS incidents
2. Identify top client user-agents and enable header throttles
3. Reduce failover aggressiveness and apply retry backoff
4. If traffic_shift >15% -> scale in-region proxies and notify GTM if >1% customer impact
5. Create suppression keys for autoscale events to avoid paging noise
```
Marcus: autoscaler added 3 proxy instances in eu-west-2 at 2048573200 trying to handle retries; added suppression tag to avoid alerting on scale-only blips.
Elena: provider DNS partial restore reported at 2048573260. synthetic checks passing 3/5 then 5/5 by 2048573340.
Priya: monitoring after throttles and backoff: 5xx rate dropped from 4.5% -> 1.6% over 10m. traffic slowly shifting back to eu-west-2.
SRE-Lead: next steps: 1) change alert evaluation window from 3m->5m and require absolute >150 errors, 2) add traffic-shift alert rule (>=15% change in 3m) and a panel for "fraction_of_requests_by_region", 3) add suppression rules for known synthetic flaps and autoscale events, 4) add a synthetic that exercises tokenization endpoint every 30s in eu-west-2. Assign Elena + Marcus to INF-90211.
Oncall-Joe: handing off oncall to Marcus for the remainder of the rotation. Marcus you're primary; Priya and Elena will stay on the thread.
Marcus: taking oncall. scheduling 45-min postmortem tomorrow; I'll include alert-change PR, dashboard JSON, and runbook diffs.
Observability-Bot: Created ephemeral PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/202 with panel JSON and query snippets (staging tests scheduled).
SRE-Lead: also make sure the runbook includes guidance on coordinating with GTM for customers impacted >0.5% and add an escalation path for exec updates if >2% impact sustained >15m.
Priya: PR for SDK throttle metrics and monitoring added: https://github.com/redwood/proxy-config/pull/455. will include test vectors and UA suppression list.
Marcus: metrics stable, eu-west-2 5xx -> 1.2%, traffic back to normal fractions. closing active page, leaving follow-ups INF-90211 for alert/dashboard work and INF-90212 for synth + runbook.
Incident-Bot: Incident resolved (automatic). Summary: transient provider DNS flap caused regional 5xx spike and traffic shift; mitigations included SDK throttles, retry-backoff, reduced failover aggressiveness, autoscale suppression, and new ephemeral dashboard panels. Follow-ups: INF-90211 (alert tuning + dashboard), INF-90212 (synth checks + runbook), INF-90213 (GTM outreach if any residual customer-impact). :white_check_mark:
